The '''Aurean Glassworkers Guild''' was a group of expert [[Artisan/Legends|artisans]] who lived in the [[Torragan Mountains]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aurea]], in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. They used the [[Eternal Furnace]], a giant [[Magma/Legends|lava]] pool for their most audacious and important projects. Apprentices to the guild spend many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] just developing the tolerances necessary to work in the presence of such fiery heat, and the most incredible works of glass known in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] come from the artisans who work with the Furnace.
